description: Decisive q-degree scan proving no low-degree qZeilberger telescoper exists for the Borromean diagonal colored Jones — the minimal recurrence is intrinsically high-degree; qZeilberger does not reduce it

verdict.decisive_finding: NO low-degree qZeilberger telescoper exists. The operator-part of the telescoping nullspace grows ~linearly with the ansatz q-degree DQ (never saturating at 1), so the genuine minimal recurrence for J_{B,n} is intrinsically HIGH-degree in q (CRT degree probe: ~126). qZeilberger does NOT reduce the operator degree — the minimal recurrence for the sum is unique, the SAME ~degree-126 object regardless of route. Therefore the explicit operator requires reconstructing ~degree-126 coefficients (the committed Rust multi-prime CRT pipeline, PR #3450), whose ONLY blocker was the compute environment (5 container restarts), NOT an algorithmic gap. q-Gosper would face the same reconstruction PLUS a certificate (strictly harder). Corrected recommendation: run the committed CRT pipeline in a persistent environment.
